lines.zh: 冰原上每一步都像敲鼓。
lines.en: Every step on the ice sounds like a drum.

lines.zh: 慢慢走，墙和栅栏都拦不住我。
lines.en: Slow and steady, walls and fences can't stop me.

lines.zh: 四只脚踩实了再迈下一步。
lines.en: Four feet planted before the next step.

lines.zh: 这冰刺城堡的地面真够凉的。
lines.en: The floor of this ice-spike castle is chilly.

lines.zh: 背上的箱子稳得很，晃不着。
lines.en: The chest on my back rides steady.

lines.zh: 幼崽跟在后面，我走慢点。
lines.en: The little one follows; I'll slow down.

lines.zh: 走过冰脊，影子拖得老长。
lines.en: Crossing the ice ridge, my shadow stretches long.
A fence? I just step over it.

lines.zh: 这步子沉，但走起来踏实。
lines.en: Heavy steps, but they feel sure.

lines.zh: 绕过石柱，别把箱子磕了。
lines.en: Around the pillar—mind the chest.
Wind slips through the ice cracks—cold.

lines.zh: 慢慢挪，背上还有四位呢。
lines.en: Easy does it—four riders up there.
Hugging the wall to dodge the wind.

lines.zh: 一步一个雪坑，踩得实在。
lines.en: One snow crater per step, good and firm.

lines.zh: 这地方空旷，走起来痛快。
lines.en: Open ground here—good for walking.
I walk my walk; no one rushes me.

lines.zh: 蹄下冰碴子响，脆生生的。
lines.en: Ice shards crunch underfoot.
When tired, I'll find a snow patch to rest.

lines.zh: 坐下歇会儿，这冰面挺硬。
lines.en: Sitting a spell—this ice is hard.

lines.zh: 孢子花的味道还在鼻尖。
lines.en: The spore-blossom scent still lingers.
Standing quiet, causing no trouble.
Everything's in the chest—rest easy.
The wind's died down—good time for a nap.
The little one keeps nuzzling around.
The saddle's empty, waiting for riders.

lines.zh: 冰刺城堡的角落最舒服。
lines.en: The corner of the ice-spike castle is comfiest.

lines.zh: 我这么大个，站着就是道墙。
lines.en: This big—standing here, I'm a wall.
Breathing slow, no rush, no fuss.

lines.zh: 杜鹃叶的味儿，闻着精神。
lines.en: The azalea-leaf smell perks me up.
No one around—just me, then.

lines.zh: 脚边雪积了一层，懒得动。
lines.en: Snow piled at my feet—can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 歇好了再走，不急这一时。
lines.en: Rest first, walk later—no hurry.

lines.zh: 你站那儿，我看得清清楚楚。
lines.en: You standing there—I see you clear.
What's in your hand? Don't wave it around.
A big one like me doesn't hit unprovoked.
Want to ride? Let me know you first.

lines.zh: 你离我后腿远些，那里看不见。
lines.en: Stay clear of my hind legs — I cannot see there.
No beetroot smell on you.

lines.zh: 冰刺城堡里少见你这样的。
lines.en: Rare to see your kind in this ice castle.

lines.zh: 盯着我干嘛？我脸上有雪？
lines.en: Why stare? Snow on my face?
You go on—I'll just stand here.

lines.zh: 背上的箱子装得下不少东西。
lines.en: The chest on my back holds plenty.
The little one's here—mind your step.

lines.zh: 你要喂我？我可不随便吃。
lines.en: Feeding me? I don't just eat anything.

lines.zh: 栅栏挡得住你，挡不住我。
lines.en: Fences stop you, not me.
Take it slow—don't startle me.
Pain or not, I hold my ground.
That one drew a grunt from me.
I know who struck me.
Hit me, and I get riled.
The wound burns—I move slowly.
Don't push me into a fury.
Chest mustn't fall—I shield it.
A sting—won't kill me.

lines.zh: 我倒要看看你还敢不敢来。
lines.en: Let's see if you dare come again.
Little one, don't fear—I can take it.
Beetroot? Bring it here, let me sniff.
That red root looks about right.

lines.zh: 你举着甜菜根，我眼神挪不开。
lines.en: You hold up beetroot—my eyes won't move.
I'm not greedy—this is the exception.

lines.zh: 闻着味儿我就坐不住了。
lines.en: One whiff and I can't sit still.
Beetroot in hand—don't wave it.
Gonna give it? I'm waiting.
That smell pulls me forward.

lines.zh: 你手一伸，我就跟过去了。
lines.en: Your hand out—I'll follow.

lines.zh: 别逗我，甜菜根不是玩具。
lines.en: Don't tease—beetroot's no toy.

lines.zh: 我鼻尖都凑到你手边了。
lines.en: My nose is right at your hand.

lines.zh: 吃了这个，我怕是要上头。
lines.en: Eat this and I might get worked up.
Oops, bumped—let me shift.

lines.zh: 我这身板大，碰着你别怪。
lines.en: Big frame here—don't blame the bump.
Easy—don't run into my legs.
Narrow path—I'll turn sideways.
A bump's fine—I'm tough.
Steady there—I'll step aside.
Icy floor—can't stop a bump.
Not so close—I turn slowly.
Did I bump you? Didn't mean to.
Make way—I take up room.
Offer the spore blossom—I understand.
Two spore blossoms, a pair.

lines.zh: 这味儿熟悉，是伴侣来了。
lines.en: That scent—my mate's here.
Approach slow—don't startle.
Spore blossom opens—I get it.
Standing side by side, quiet.
In the ice castle, a companion.
Easy—sniff each other first.
Spore blossoms on the snow—just right.

lines.zh: 往后有小幼崽跟着走了。
lines.en: Soon a little one will follow us.
Set the chest on my back—I'll carry it.

lines.zh: 这箱子搁稳了，四十九格够用。
lines.en: Chest's secure—forty-nine slots, plenty.

lines.zh: 东西放进来，我替你背着。
lines.en: Put it in—I'll haul it for you.
The chest's not heavy—I can walk.

lines.zh: 背上多一箱，照样跨栅栏。
lines.en: One more chest—I still cross fences.

lines.zh: 装好了就上路，别落下东西。
lines.en: Loaded up—let's go, don't leave anything.

lines.zh: 这箱子挂我身上正合适。
lines.en: The chest sits just right on me.
Hand it over—I'll carry it steady.
Lid latched—no rattling as I walk.
Plenty of room up there—load it on.

lines.zh: 那边有灾厄村民，我盯上了。
lines.en: Illagers over there—I've got my eye on them.

lines.zh: 闻到灾厄味儿了，别想跑。
lines.en: Caught the illager stench—no running.
Who's moving over there? Hold it.
Grey-robed one—I've marked you.

lines.zh: 灾厄村民靠近了，我起身。
lines.en: Illagers closing in—I'm up.
Movement—not one of ours.
Those few ahead—I'll handle them.

lines.zh: 别以为我站着就是没看见。
lines.en: Don't think standing means I'm blind.
Illagers stepping on my ice.
Target's right ahead, not far.
You lot—bad luck meeting me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，已经锁定了。
lines.en: Turning slow—already locked on.
Hold still—I'm watching you.
You go left, my head turns left.
Can't outrun me—long strides.
Illager, don't try to circle behind.

lines.zh: 我盯得紧，你喘气我都听见。
lines.en: Watching close—I hear you breathe.

lines.zh: 再凑近，我就把箱子放下来。
lines.en: One step closer and I set my crate down.
On this ice you can't outslide me.
You back off, I shuffle along.
No tricks—I see clear.
They're scheming—I'll wait.
Raise your hand—still watching.
Just the right distance—closer and I swing.

lines.zh: 你躲进棚子，我就在外头等。
lines.en: Hide in the shed; I wait outside.
This one's for you.
Illager—take it square.
Slow swing, heavy hit.
Stop dodging—you can't.
Bear down—see if you stand.
This swat isn't light.

lines.zh: 冰面上挨一下，够你受的。
lines.en: One hit on the ice—that'll sting.
I flatten fences at my size.
This shove—steady and true.
Grey robe—taste this.
After this blow, I'm still watching.

lines.zh: 蹄子落下去，冰碴子乱飞。
lines.en: My hoof comes down and ice chips scatter.

lines.zh: 冰刺城堡里，我醒过来了。
lines.en: In the ice-spike castle, I wake.

lines.zh: 这地方冷，我倒觉得刚好。
lines.en: Cold here—just how I like it.
Ice underfoot—steady first.
This big—the roof feels low.
Just arrived—let me look around.
Back's empty—no chest yet.
Icicles hang—I move carefully.
Empty castle—just me.

lines.zh: 风灌进来，我缩了缩脖子。
lines.en: Wind pours in—I duck my neck.
Who put me here?
Sit a moment—just landed.
Snow dust all over me.
Big place—room to move.
Easy does it—learn the paths.
Light outside—ice glinting.
I'm here—now I walk, slowly.

lines.zh: 身上着了火，我赶紧打滚。
lines.en: I'm on fire—I roll to smother it.
The landing jolts me silly.
Water in my nose—I shove upward.
The shockwave staggers me.
Something hit me—who threw that?

lines.zh: 这说不清的劲让我发慌。
lines.en: This inexplicable force unsettles me.
My belly growls—walking feels floaty.

lines.zh: 雷打在身上，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hit me—I shuddered.

lines.zh: 底下空空的，我直往下落。
lines.en: Nothing below—I fall straight down.
